# Approval Workflow v1.0
# Comprehensive approval workflow framework for prompt governance

approval_workflow:
  version: "1.0"
  last_updated: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  
  # Workflow configuration
  workflow_configuration:
    approval_stages:
      - name: "initial_review"
        description: "Initial review of prompt proposal"
        required_approvers: 1
        approver_roles: ["prompt_engineer", "subject_matter_expert"]
        timeout_hours: 48
        auto_approve: false
        
      - name: "technical_review"
        description: "Technical implementation and quality review"
        required_approvers: 2
        approver_roles: ["technical_lead", "quality_assurance"]
        timeout_hours: 72
        auto_approve: false
        
      - name: "compliance_review"
        description: "Compliance and ethical review"
        required_approvers: 1
        approver_roles: ["compliance_officer", "ethics_reviewer"]
        timeout_hours: 96
        auto_approve: false
